draft.subject: Robotics Electrical Engineering Intern | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied for the Robotics Electrical Engineering Intern role at RoboForce and wanted to reach out, since you lead the robotics software side and would likely know who owns hiring for the hardware and firmware team.

My background is hands on embedded work. I have programmed STM32 peripherals in bare metal C, including GPIO, timers, ADC, and I2C for a temperature monitoring build, and built closed loop heading correction on an Arduino robot using quadrature encoder feedback and PWM motor control.

If you have a few minutes, I would appreciate a short call to talk through what the team looks for in this role, or point me toward whoever runs the hiring process for it.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
